offence_note: Home invasion robbery with firearm; firearm offences

offence_note: Break and enter and theft; four breaches of recognizance

note: Three years for break and enter and theft; time served on breaches.

note: Appeal only about enhanced credit; 1:1 credit for 1083 days.

note: Suspended sentence on firearm counts; 7 days consecutive for failing to appear; 12 months curfew.

offence_note: Narcotics possession or trafficking, details not shown
